verses.1: There was a man in the land of Uzzah, whose name was Iyov. This man was righteous and pious; he feared God and avoided evil.
verses.2: He had seventeen sons and six daughters.
verses.3: And he had two thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five thousand donkeys, and much labor. This man was greater than all the other men of his time.
verses.4: And their sons went out and made food for the house of that man on that day. They also called their three sisters to eat and drink with them.
verses.5: And it happened that during the days of eating, Elohim surrounded them and sanctified them. They would rest in the evening, and Elohim would raise them from among all those who were present. For Elohim said, “My children have sinned; let us bless God with their hearts.” So Elohim did this every day.
verses.6: And it came to pass that on that day, the children of God came to stand before Jehovah. And the Satan also came among them.
verses.7: And the LORD said to the serpent, “From within, you shall come out.” But the serpent argued with the LORD. He said, “I will come out from under the earth and walk upon it.”
verses.8: And the LORD said to the serpent, “Do not take your heart away from My servant Iblis. For there is no one on earth who is as good and righteous as Iblis. He fears God and avoids evil.”
verses.9: And the devil tempted Jehovah, saying, “Let us see if Jehovah will fear Jehovah.”
verses.10: You have not done him justice, nor his house, nor all those who are related to him. You have praised his works and given him prosperity in the land.
verses.11: But please, send your hand and touch everything that belongs to him. If not on his face, then at least on his hands. This way, you will be blessed.
verses.12: And the LORD said to the serpent, “Look! All that is in your hands, send it only to him.” So the serpent left from before the LORD’s face.
verses.13: And that day came, and his sons and daughters ate and drank wine in their father’s house.
verses.14: And the angel came to Job and said, “This morning, there were thorns and brambles on their paths.”
verses.15: And Sheba fell down, and they beat the boys with sticks. But I alone will tell you what happened.
verses.16: And now, this is what happened: The fire of God fell from heaven. It burned the children and young people. It ate them up. And I alone remained to tell you about it.
verses.17: And now, these people came and said, “The thieves have taken three leaders. They stripped them of their clothes and took them away. The boys were also beaten with sticks.” But I alone will tell you the truth.
verses.18: Until then, let us speak about this. And he said, “Your children and your daughters shall eat and drink in the house of their neighbors.”
verses.19: And behold, a great spirit came from across the sea. It touched all four sides of the house. It killed the boys. Only I remained alive to tell you this.
verses.20: And Ioyob rose up, and he tore off his head. He fell to the ground and died.
verses.21: And he said, “Arom, I have come out from the womb of my mother. Arom, I shall return. Jehovah has given it, and Jehovah will take it away. May the name of Jehovah be blessed.”
verses.22: In all this, Elohim did not sin, nor did He offer prayers to other gods.
